# Official parser regression fixtures

These two unmodified non-family fixtures come from the MIT-licensed exifr repository.

- capture.jpg: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr/blob/master/test/fixtures/IMG_20180725_163423-tiny.jpg
- capture.heic: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr/blob/master/test/fixtures/heic-iphone7.heic
- Project/license: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr

Downloaded 2026-09-13 solely to exercise real JPEG and HEIC parsing. No family media is included. Expected coordinates/time in tests are explicit fixture values, not copied from the production transformation algorithm.
